items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I worked with Gerry for a couple of years you know after Gary’s group broke up you know I played a lot with Gerry.

ctx.x: Either it has to do with alcohol and drugs possibly or you know bad intentions. So I don’t know, it’s all been — I can’t think of things that were really awful but there were funny

things that happened. Like when I was playing with Gerry Mulligan in a club in New York. I worked with Gerry for a couple of years you know after Gary’s group broke up you know I played a lot with Gerry. I played with Al Cohn and Zoot Sims, with Stan Getz for a little while. You know I was playing a lot of gigs. And Bobby Hackett. You know gigs in New York mostly, sometimes on the road like Chicago or someplace. I think I went to Detroit with Stan, Chicago. Oh I was touring. A lot of work with Mose Allison. We…
